review.notes: Independent source-evidence re-review verified 5 frozen Git blobs and exact SHA-256 values at 431feefd1be365ba45c034da7c9b33616108bc66. sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu workflow explicitly selects pnpm 9 and runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, overriding the generated pnpm 8 choice.
Target Hacker News manifest requires Node 18 or newer and is installed through the root workspace.
Root manifest defines workspace-wide pnpm scripts but does not pin a pnpm patch.
Frozen root workspace lock is bound exactly; its lockfileVersion 6 conflicts with the repository's pnpm 9 CI transition and needs a probe.
